**Handlers that transitively trigger an outbound request to a user‑configured URL** (all in `server/router/api/v1/`, all gRPC/API service methods on `APIV1Service`):

- `CreateMemo` — `server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go:70` (calls `DispatchMemoCreatedWebhook` at line 157)
- `UpdateMemo` — `server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go:401` (calls `dispatchMemoUpdatedSideEffects` → `DispatchMemoUpdatedWebhook` at line 513)
- `DeleteMemo` — `server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go:518` (calls `DispatchMemoDeletedWebhook` at line 562)
- `SetMemoAttachments` — `server/router/api/v1/memo_attachment_service.go:16` (calls `dispatchMemoUpdatedSideEffects` at line 48)
- `SetMemoRelations` — `server/router/api/v1/memo_relation_service.go:16` (calls `dispatchMemoUpdatedSideEffects` at line 48)
- `CreateMemoComment` — `server/router/api/v1/memo_service_comments.go:20` (calls `DispatchMemoCommentCreatedWebhook` at line 119)

Each of these ends up in `dispatchMemoRelatedWebhook`/`DispatchMemoCommentCreatedWebhook` in `server/router/api/v1/memo_service_webhooks.go`, which loads the caller's webhooks via `s.Store.GetUserWebhooks` (URLs the user registered through `CreateUserWebhook`/`UpdateUserWebhook` in `server/router/api/v1/user_service_webhooks.go:53,106`) and calls `webhook.PostAsync(payload)`.

**Convergence function**: all of these paths funnel into `Post` in `internal/webhook/webhook.go:120`, which is where the actual outbound HTTP request is issued (`safeClient.Do(req)` at `internal/webhook/webhook.go:152`; `PostAsync` at line 184 just enqueues to `asyncPostQueue`, whose worker goroutines, started in `init()`, call `Post` for delivery).
